data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

HomeRecipesAbout

Blueberry Scones

Published: 2025-09-15

These delicious blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or an afternoon treat. They are buttery, flaky, and loaded with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Let cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with a simple glaze.

Nutritional Information (per scone)

Calories280
Fat14g
Carbohydrates35g

data.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

HomeRecipesAbout

Blueberry Scones

Published: 2025-09-15

These delicious blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or an afternoon treat. They are buttery, flaky, and loaded with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Let cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with a simple glaze.

Nutritional Information (per scone)

Calories280
Fat14g
Carbohydrates35g

data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

HomeRecipesAbout

Blueberry Scones

Published: 2025-09-15

These delicious blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or an afternoon treat. They are buttery, flaky, and loaded with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Let cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with a simple glaze.

Nutritional Information (per scone)

Calories280
Fat14g
Carbohydrates35g
